high_level_description: The image is a split-screen photograph featuring a person dressed as Medusa for Halloween. The individual is depicted in two different angles, showcasing the costume's intricate details. Left Side: The person is shown from a close-up angle, focusing on their face and upper body. They have a reptilian appearance with scales covering their skin, giving them a scaly texture. Their hair is styled to resemble Medusa's iconic snakes, which are intertwined and appear to be made of a similar material as the rest of the costume.
